package.name: limo_cobot_moveit_config
package.description: MoveIt 2 configuration for the combined LIMO + myCobot 280 mobile manipulator. A deliberately thin planning layer: MoveIt plans the 6-DOF arm group only. The gripper is driven directly by topic (outside MoveIt), and navigation is handled by the existing visual-servo controller. The robot description lives in the limo_car package (gazebo/ackermann_with_sensor.xacro).
